facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: He made gifts for the elves. The elves were happy. Everyone was glad. He became rich and happy.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The shoemaker wanted to thank the elves for everything. He and his wife made tiny clothes and shoes for them. The elves found the gifts and danced with pure joy. He became rich and happy because he was grateful. The elves never came back, but he always remembered them. His kindness and gratitude filled his heart with warmth.
facts.Word cards: happy = 행복한 / became = 됐다 / thankful = 감사한 / rich = 부자인
